title: SundaySMP
description: SundaySMP is a Minecraft Server where you try to become the best player by grinding to get loot and by fighting others. The server is joinable on any version.
body: SundaySMP is a Minecraft Server where you try to become the best player by grinding to get loot and by fighting others. The server is joinable on any modern 1.21+ version. The IP is sundaysmp.fun for both Java and Bedrock edition.
